name.zh-CN: 核心诊断设备：影像、检验与病理

description.zh-CN: 64 排螺旋 CT：环形机架孔径约 75 厘米，配可升降、可穿过机架的碳纤维检查床。
description.en: A 64-slice helical CT scanner with a ~75 cm ring-gantry bore and a motorised carbon-fibre couch that slides through it.

usage.zh-CN: 核对申请与禁忌（妊娠、造影剂过敏、肾功能）后摆位，由技师在控制室扫描；平扫或增强 CT 图像在影像工作站调阅。
usage.en: Check the request and contraindications (pregnancy, contrast allergy, renal function), position the patient and scan from the control room; review plain or contrast CT on an imaging workstation.

prompt.zh-CN: E · 使用 CT 扫描仪

description.zh-CN: 1.5 T 超导磁共振：深长磁体、约 60 厘米孔径和喇叭口入口，配头线圈与对接式检查床。
description.en: A 1.5 T superconducting MRI with a deep magnet, ~60 cm flared bore, head coil and docking patient table.

usage.zh-CN: 检查前必须完成 MRI 安全筛查（起搏器、金属植入物、幽闭恐惧、怀孕）；扫描时间较长，需要患者静止配合。
usage.en: Complete MRI safety screening first (pacemaker, metal implants, claustrophobia, pregnancy); scans take longer and need a still, cooperative patient.

name.zh-CN: 数字 X 线摄影机

description.zh-CN: 数字化 X 线摄影系统：落地立柱球管与限束器悬于浮动床面检查床之上，床下为平板探测器滤线器。
description.en: A digital radiography system: a floor-mounted tube column with collimator over a floating-top table with a flat-panel detector Bucky.

usage.zh-CN: 用于胸片、腹部平片和骨骼摄影：对准球管与探测器、调整照射野后曝光，图像随即上传 PACS。
usage.en: For chest, abdominal and skeletal radiographs: align tube and detector, collimate and expose; images go straight to PACS.

prompt.zh-CN: E · 使用 X 线机

description.zh-CN: 立式胸片架：可升降平板探测器、中心十字标记和侧位抓握扶手。
description.en: An upright chest stand with a height-adjustable flat-panel detector, centring cross-hair and handgrips for lateral views.

usage.zh-CN: 患者胸部贴紧探测器、双手扶握、深吸气后屏气，拍摄后前位或侧位胸片；与 X 线机配合使用。
usage.en: The patient presses the chest to the detector, holds the grips and takes a deep breath in for PA or lateral films; used together with the X-ray tube.

description.zh-CN: 移动式 C 形臂 X 线机：C 形臂下端为 X 线球管、上端为平板探测器，可在手术台旁实时透视。
description.en: A mobile C-arm with the X-ray tube at the lower end of the C and a flat-panel detector at the top, for real-time fluoroscopy at the table.

usage.zh-CN: 介入或术中围绕患者摆放 C 形臂进行实时透视；操作人员穿铅衣并尽量缩短透视时间。
usage.en: Wheel it to the table and position the C around the patient for live fluoroscopy during procedures; staff wear lead and keep screening time short.

prompt.zh-CN: E · 使用 C 形臂透视

description.zh-CN: PET/CT 一体机：前方 CT 机架与后方更大的 PET 探测环串联，长检查床贯穿两个孔径。
description.en: An integrated PET/CT: a CT gantry in front of a larger PET detector ring, with a long couch running through both bores.

usage.zh-CN: 注射 18F-FDG 等示踪剂并安静休息约 60 分钟后扫描；用于肿瘤分期、疗效评估和不明原因发热等。
usage.en: Scan about 60 minutes after an 18F-FDG (or other tracer) injection and quiet rest; used for cancer staging, treatment response and fever of unknown origin.

description.zh-CN: 推车式彩色多普勒超声仪：高分辨率显示屏、带轨迹球的控制面板、三把探头和热敏打印机。
description.en: A cart-based colour Doppler ultrasound system with a high-resolution monitor, trackball console, three probes and a thermal printer.

usage.zh-CN: 选择合适探头（凸阵、线阵、相控阵）并涂耦合剂，完成腹部、血管、产科或经胸超声心动图检查。
usage.en: Choose the right probe (curved, linear or phased array), apply gel and perform abdominal, vascular, obstetric or transthoracic echocardiography studies.

description.zh-CN: 床旁即时超声（POCUS）：平板式主机装在五爪脚轮立杆上，配一把探头和耗材篮。
description.en: A point-of-care ultrasound tablet on a five-caster pole stand with a probe holder and supply basket.

usage.zh-CN: 推到床旁快速完成 eFAST、肺部 B 线、下腔静脉评估或引导穿刺；结果需结合临床解读。
usage.en: Bring it to the bedside for a quick eFAST, lung B-lines, IVC assessment or needle guidance; interpret findings in clinical context.

description.zh-CN: 影像控制台兼阅片工作站：三台显示器（扫描控制与 PACS 诊断屏）、扫描控制盒和对讲话筒，背后是铅玻璃观察窗。
description.en: Radiology control console and reading station: three monitors (scan control and PACS diagnostic displays), scan control box and intercom in front of a lead-glass viewing window.

usage.zh-CN: 在此调阅 PACS 图像、对比既往检查并书写影像报告；可开具的影像检查取决于该工位放置时配置的能力。
usage.en: Review PACS images, compare prior studies and write reports here; which imaging studies can be ordered depends on the capabilities configured on this placement.

description.zh-CN: 壁挂式双联 X 线观片灯，夹着两张胸片。
description.en: A wall-mounted double X-ray film viewer with two chest films clipped on.

usage.zh-CN: 打开背光对比新旧胶片；如今多用 PACS 阅片，观片灯常用于会诊和教学。
usage.en: Switch on the backlight to compare old and new films; largely replaced by PACS but still handy for case conferences and teaching.

description.zh-CN: 落地式五分类血细胞分析仪：自动进样器上排着紫帽 EDTA 抗凝管，带触摸屏和运行指示灯。
description.en: A floor-standing five-part-differential haematology analyser with an autoloader of purple-top EDTA tubes, a touchscreen and run indicators.

usage.zh-CN: 上机检测血常规（血红蛋白、白细胞分类、血小板）及凝血；异常报警提示复检或人工推片镜检。
usage.en: Runs the full blood count (haemoglobin, white-cell differential, platelets) and coagulation; flagged results prompt a rerun or a manual blood film.

description.zh-CN: 大型全自动生化免疫分析仪：透明罩下有试剂盘与反应盘，前置样本传输轨道，顶部三色状态灯。
description.en: A large automated chemistry and immunoassay analyser: reagent carousel and reaction disk under clear covers, a front sample-rack conveyor and a three-colour status beacon.

usage.zh-CN: 检测电解质、肝肾功能、心肌标志物、激素与血清学指标；黄帽或绿帽管离心后放入样本架上机。
usage.en: Measures electrolytes, renal and liver function, cardiac markers, hormones and serology; centrifuged gold- or green-top tubes are loaded in racks.

description.zh-CN: 推车式血气分析仪：前置触摸屏、进样口、侧挂试剂包和小票打印机。
description.en: A cart-mounted blood gas analyser with a front touchscreen, sample inlet, side reagent pack and receipt printer.

usage.zh-CN: 采集肝素化动脉或静脉血、排尽气泡后立即进样，约 1 分钟得到 pH、PaO2、PaCO2、乳酸与电解质。
usage.en: Inject a bubble-free heparinised arterial or venous sample straight away; pH, PaO2, PaCO2, lactate and electrolytes are ready in about a minute.

description.zh-CN: 落地式冷冻离心机，带锁定穹顶上盖、控制面板与进风格栅。
description.en: A floor-standing refrigerated centrifuge with a locking domed lid, control panel and air-intake grille.

usage.zh-CN: 对称配平后离心血标本以分离血清或血浆，再送生化、免疫或血库检测。
usage.en: Balance the tubes symmetrically and spin blood samples to separate serum or plasma before chemistry, immunoassay or blood-bank testing.

description.zh-CN: 小型实验台上的双目光学显微镜，带摄像头、载玻片盒和镜油。
description.en: A binocular light microscope with a camera on a small bench, with a slide box and immersion oil.

usage.zh-CN: 阅读血涂片、骨髓、细胞学和组织病理切片：从低倍镜找到目标区域，再转高倍或油镜观察细节。
usage.en: Read blood films, bone-marrow, cytology and histology slides: find the area at low power, then move to high power or oil immersion for detail.

description.zh-CN: 实验室边台：黑色环氧树脂台面、下柜与抽屉、试剂层架，台上有试管架、移液器和涡旋混匀器。
description.en: A laboratory bench with a black epoxy worktop, base cabinets and drawers, reagent shelving, tube racks, pipettes and a vortex mixer.

usage.zh-CN: 用于手工检测、样本分装、登记与试剂准备；处理样本时戴手套并及时丢弃锐器。
usage.en: Work surface for manual tests, sample aliquoting, logging and reagent preparation; wear gloves and dispose of sharps promptly.

description.zh-CN: II 级 A2 型生物安全柜：可升降玻璃前窗、不锈钢工作台面、HEPA 排风与内部照明。
description.en: A Class II A2 biosafety cabinet with a sliding glass sash, stainless worktop, HEPA exhaust and interior light.

usage.zh-CN: 在柜内处理培养物、涂片和潜在感染性标本（革兰染色、培养接种、快速抗原/PCR）；工作前后通风并消毒台面。
usage.en: Handle cultures, smears and potentially infectious specimens inside (Gram stain, culture inoculation, rapid antigen/PCR); run the airflow and disinfect the worktop before and after work.

description.zh-CN: 玻璃门实验室冷藏柜（2–8 ℃），分层存放试剂盒与待检样本，带温度显示。
description.en: A glass-door laboratory refrigerator (2–8 °C) with shelves of reagent kits and pending samples, and a temperature display.

usage.zh-CN: 按标签分区存放试剂、质控品与样本，取放后及时关门并每日记录温度。
usage.en: Store labelled reagents, controls and samples in their zones, close the door promptly and log the temperature daily.

description.zh-CN: 台式多色流式细胞仪，下方放鞘液桶与废液桶，旁边是分析电脑。
description.en: A benchtop multicolour flow cytometer with sheath and waste tanks below and an analysis PC alongside.

usage.zh-CN: 对血液或骨髓标本进行免疫分型（CD 抗原表达），用于白血病、淋巴瘤和免疫缺陷的诊断与随访。
usage.en: Immunophenotypes blood or bone-marrow samples (CD antigen expression) to diagnose and follow leukaemia, lymphoma and immunodeficiency.

description.zh-CN: 全自动尿液分析系统：干化学试纸条读数与尿沉渣有形成分分析，前置进样架，置于设备柜上。
description.en: An automated urinalysis system combining dipstick reading and urine sediment analysis, with a front sample rack, on an equipment cabinet.

usage.zh-CN: 上机检测尿常规与尿沉渣，也可读取尿酮体和尿妊娠试验；异常有形成分提示人工镜检复核。
usage.en: Runs urine dipstick and sediment analysis, including urine ketones and pregnancy tests; abnormal sediment prompts manual microscopy.

description.zh-CN: 靠墙安装的气动物流收发站：发送舱门、站号键盘、接收篮与传输瓶，管道向上穿入墙体。
description.en: A wall-mounted pneumatic tube station with send hatch, station keypad, catch basket and carrier; the tube runs up into the wall.

usage.zh-CN: 将标本装袋放入传输瓶、关紧后插入发送口并输入目的站号，即可送往检验科、病理科或血库。
usage.en: Bag the specimens, close them in a carrier, insert it in the send hatch and key in the destination to reach the lab, pathology or blood bank.

description.zh-CN: 细胞遗传学工作站：带摄像头的研究级显微镜、运行核型分析软件的双显示器和主机。
description.en: A cytogenetics workstation: a research microscope with camera, dual monitors running karyotyping software and a PC.

usage.zh-CN: 采集中期分裂相进行核型分析、判读 FISH 信号并审核分子检测结果；可开具的检查取决于该工位能力。
usage.en: Capture metaphases for karyotyping, score FISH signals and review molecular results; available tests depend on the workstation's capabilities.

description.zh-CN: 数字病理切片扫描仪：前置玻片篮装载窗、触摸屏和状态灯带，置于设备柜上。
description.en: A digital pathology slide scanner on a cabinet, with a front slide-basket loading window, touchscreen and status light bar.

usage.zh-CN: 将染色切片装篮后批量扫描成全视野数字图像，用于远程会诊、教学和 AI 辅助阅片。
usage.en: Load stained slides in baskets and batch-scan them into whole-slide images for remote consults, teaching and AI-assisted reading.

description.zh-CN: 旋转式石蜡切片机，侧面有大手轮，前方为刀架和标本夹，旁边是摊片水浴锅。
description.en: A rotary paraffin microtome with a big side handwheel, blade holder and specimen clamp, next to a flotation water bath.

usage.zh-CN: 将石蜡包埋组织块切成 3–5 微米薄片，漂浮于温水浴中展平后捞到载玻片上待染色。
usage.en: Cuts paraffin-embedded tissue blocks into 3–5 µm sections, which are floated flat on the warm water bath and picked up on slides for staining.

description.zh-CN: 全封闭组织脱水机：顶部反应罐和石蜡缸，下部玻璃门内可见乙醇、二甲苯等试剂瓶，触摸屏控制。
description.en: An enclosed tissue processor with a retort and paraffin baths on top, alcohol and xylene bottles behind the lower glass door, and a touchscreen.

usage.zh-CN: 按程序对福尔马林固定后的组织依次脱水、透明和浸蜡，通常过夜运行，次日包埋切片。
usage.en: Runs formalin-fixed tissue through dehydration, clearing and paraffin infiltration, usually overnight, ready for embedding and sectioning next day.

description.zh-CN: 内镜主机车：高清监视器、视频处理器、冷光源、CO2 送气泵和吸引装置，侧面挂着电子胃镜。
description.en: An endoscopy stack with HD monitor, video processor, light source, CO2 insufflator and suction unit, with a video gastroscope hanging at the side.

usage.zh-CN: 用于胃镜、结肠镜等诊疗；术前核对禁食与抗凝/抗血小板药物，必要时取活检送病理。
usage.en: For gastroscopy, colonoscopy and therapeutic endoscopy; check fasting and anticoagulant/antiplatelet drugs beforehand and send biopsies to pathology.
